name: Chenaanah
overview: Chenaanah is a male figure identified in Scripture primarily as the father of Zedekiah. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His mention is concise, focusing on his paternal connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Chenaanah means "toward Canaan" in Hebrew, reflecting a proper name without indication of divine origin. This name appears in 1 Kings 22:11, providing a cultural and linguistic background to his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Chenaanah as the father of Zedekiah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Chenaanah's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his role as the father of Zedekiah, linking him to the prophetic and royal contexts found in 1 Kings 22:11 and 2 Chronicles 18:10. While details about Chenaanah himself are minimal, his mention anchors the identity of his son within the historical and spiritual record of Israel.
